notes.title: [Important Notice] Pomegranate Housing Complex Release Date Postponement
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support. We have an important announcement to make.

The release date, originally scheduled for October 31st, will be postponed to sometime in December.

We sincerely apologize to everyone who has added the game to their wishlist and those who have played the demo version.


Reason for Postponement 
During development, we have experienced significant delays in text and visual asset creation, resulting in overall progress falling short of our expectations.

Rather than prioritizing the original deadline and compromising on quality, we have decided that extending the development period is necessary to deliver a better product to you.


Current Development Status
Core Systems: 90%

Backgrounds: 90%

Character Art: 80%

CG Illustrations: 15%

Text: 30% (Plot is nearly complete)

Implementation: 20%

Overall Progress: 50%

Through this postponement, we are committed to developing a more satisfying work that meets our standards.

We will continue to provide progress updates as development continues. Please wait a little longer until completion.

notes.title: Pomegranate Housing Complex Trial version Ver1.02 is now available
notes.notes:
Thank you for your assistance. 



We have just updated the boxwood estate demo version with the fixes. 

This is our first release on Steam, so there may be a lot of clumsiness. 
This update
Fixed a bug that the time keeps going forward after 24:00.  

Simple fixes to the UI 

Added new way to play (described in the operation instructions) 

Modified build package (to address the issue of not being able to start the game) 

If you find any problems with this update, we would appreciate it if you could contact us via the inquiry form on the official website. 

Thank you in advance for your cooperation. 

This is a very important issue for us. 



Korekoreshikazika, kizinago

notes.title: Announcement of PHC Demo Version & Crowdfunding [May 17, 2025]
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support.

This time, I would like to announce the trial version of "Pomegranate housing complex" and the crowdfunding of this work.

There are a lot of events next week, so I will do my best.

About the Pomegranate housing complex demo version

Scheduled release date

Tuesday, May 21, 2025

It is scheduled to be submitted for review on the 19th.
If it does not go well, it will be postponed.

As this is my first attempt and a personal production and sale, I think there will be many shortcomings, but I would appreciate your understanding. .

Distribution site

 Steam
 itch.io
 BOOTH


Currently, the trial version is scheduled to be distributed on the day Windows only.
This is because the author does not own a Mac due to his working environment... I'm sorry.

However, I'm hoping to release it on Mac as well, so I'd appreciate it if you could wait.

If it's difficult, I'm also considering releasing it on a browser version.

In-game specifications



 Time: 30 seconds = 1 hour

 Surveillance area: up to 2nd floor

 Patrol area: up to 2nd floor

 Phone calls: 1 type (however, the conversation content changes depending on the conditions)

 Spiritual disturbance level: 3 levels

 Ending branch: 3 types (quite simple)



Currently, volunteers are test-playing the provisional data.

Thankfully, there don't seem to be any fatal bugs... so if all goes well, it looks like it will only require minor corrections.

There are lots of gimmicks built in, so you might discover a lot of things if you play it a few times.

We look forward to seeing you all play it!

About Pomegranate housing complex Crowdfunding

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577571/0b36f65de51bdd9c0cf7ba4271f774374bf56608.png

Although it will be very short notice, we will be releasing a crowdfunding page on CAMPFIRE.

Crowdfunding release date

Saturday, May 24, 2025

Purpose of doing crowdfunding

Support for the production of the finished product version of "Pomegranate housing complex"

Target amount

300,000 yen

Reason for doing crowdfunding

Honestly, I'm very sorry...
I'm currently working part-time while developing games, but the physical and mental burden is piling up, and I'm in a position where I need to reconsider the way I work.

However, I feel very attached to "Pomegranate housing complex" so I absolutely want to complete it.

I decided to do crowdfunding so that I can have the time and environment to concentrate on creating, even if just a little.

(Although it's a hidden theme, I also hope that it will help with localization into various languages.)

I will provide more details at a later date, so please look forward to it.

We will also be exhibiting at an offline event in Tokyo on the 24th, so if you're in the area, please come and see us.
